shiftLock.slot: Cap near selector base on console
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the shift lock override slot — Cap near selector base on console.
Insert a thin key or small flathead into the slot.
Press firmly and hold.
Press the brake pedal while holding.
Move the selector to Neutral.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to N normally.
FLATBED ONLY — Subaru Symmetrical AWD cannot be disabled. No 2WD mode exists on any trim.
PHEV/hybrid variants: 12V auxiliary only — never touch the HV battery.

tow.method: FLATBED ONLY — Subaru Symmetrical AWD cannot be disabled on any model. If no flatbed available, use wheel-lift with dollies on free-rolling axle.
notes: HYBRID/PHEV: Use 12V auxiliary battery ONLY for jumping. NEVER access the high-voltage battery pack.
FULL-TIME AWD: Cannot disengage AWD. Flatbed is the safest method. If using wheel-lift, dollies MUST be used on the free-rolling axle to prevent driveline damage.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.
CVT EQUIPPED: Do NOT exceed 35 mph or 50 miles with drive wheels on ground. Flatbed strongly preferred for CVTs.

battery.jumpPoints: Under hood — standard terminals. XT PHEV: 12V only.
battery.warning: Symmetrical AWD — flatbed only on ALL Outback/Legacy. No exceptions. PHEV: 12V only.

shiftLock.slot: Cap near selector base on console (auto only)
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Cap near selector base on console (auto only).
Pry off the cap or cover if present using your ignition key or a small flathead.
Insert the key (or a thin flathead) into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove key from slot and replace cap.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood, driver side.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Cap near selector base on console (auto only).

tow.method: Lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: RWD: Lift from REAR. Rear (drive) wheels are lifted in the air. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
LOW CLEARANCE VEHICLE: Use flatbed. Check ground clearance before attempting any wheel-lift — front splitter/rear diffuser damage is common.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.

alerts.notes: Manual: clutch to N. RWD. Shared platform with Toyota GR86.

shiftLock.slot: Electronic selector — slot near selector base
steps: Turn vehicle to ON/Ready mode.
Electronic gear selector — press N while pressing brake pedal.
If power is lost: connect jump pack to 12V auxiliary under hood.
12V AUXILIARY ONLY — NEVER touch HV battery.
FLATBED ONLY — electric drivetrain.
12V auxiliary under hood.
12V AUXILIARY ONLY — never touch HV battery.
Once powered, press N while pressing brake.

notes: ELECTRIC VEHICLE: FLATBED ONLY — never tow with any driven wheels on the ground. Regenerative braking system can damage motor/inverter.
If vehicle must be moved short distance without flatbed, use dollies under ALL driven wheels.
12V battery ONLY for jumping — NEVER touch or access the high-voltage (HV) system. HV components are marked with ORANGE cables/covers.
